description:
Csat Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
